# fomkyr 0.6.3 sources

This core provides exact sparse rational reduction, a monotone radix word queue,
and budgeted shared overflow workspace with cancellation and ownership checks.
C sources, build scripts, mathematical regression tests and the MIT notice are
retained unchanged. `SOURCE.json` records their hashes and the original archive
digest. Generated reports and benchmark stores are excluded. George maintains
its browser adapter separately, including complete basis counts, expandable
previews and elapsed seconds.

Application and core versions are recorded separately in the runtime manifest.
Legacy checkpoint records and minimal metadata under `results/speed/` support
inherited compatibility tests. Rebuild in a staging directory using
`tools/build-fomkyr-backend.sh` from the George root.
